slides.title: A boring service description, **rewritten to sell**.
slides.sub: Same facts, no hype. One prompt, and both versions are inside.

before.label: WHAT THE WEBSITE SAID
before.text: We offer residential cleaning services. Our services include dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and bathroom and kitchen cleaning. We are reliable and professional. Contact us for a quote.

after.label: WHAT A BUYER THINKS
after.text: So... like every other cleaner? Why you?

slides.note: Example: Brightside Cleaning, a home cleaning service.

slides.title: It lists chores. Buyers want **answers**.
rows: Will my home actually feel done?
Will you show up every time?
Can I trust you in my house?

cards.title: Service rewrite
cards.text: Rewrite my service description so it sells, without hype. Business: [WHAT YOU DO + WHERE]. Ideal customer: [WHO + THEIR BIGGEST HASSLE]. What's different about us: [2–3 REAL FACTS]. Next step: [HOW TO BOOK]. Format: a headline, 3 short benefit lines, one clear next step. Under 90 words. Only use the facts I gave you.

slides.note: 'Only use the facts I gave you' stops it from inventing promises.

Business: home cleaning, Riverside.
Customer: busy parents who come home to a mess on Fridays.

**Come home to a clean house on Friday.**

caption:
How to rewrite your service description so it sells (without hype)

Most service pages list chores: "dusting, vacuuming, reliable, professional." Buyers want to know what changes for them.

Copy this:

"Rewrite my service description so it sells, without hype. Business: [WHAT YOU DO + WHERE]. Ideal customer: [WHO + THEIR BIGGEST HASSLE]. What's different about us: [2–3 REAL FACTS]. Next step: [HOW TO BOOK]. Format: a headline, 3 short benefit lines, one clear next step. Under 90 words. Only use the facts I gave you."

I tried it on an invented home cleaning service. "We are reliable and professional" became "Come home to a clean house on Friday", with three real facts, each turned into a reason to care.

The last line of the prompt matters most: it keeps the AI from inventing promises you can't keep.
